storage.partitioning: one file per UTC calendar day

columns.name: request_hash
columns.description: Correlation id. Server-computed for predict: sha256(text + LF + timestamp_floor_minute_utc), prefixed with sha256:. Client-supplied on feedback.

columns.name: timestamp_utc
columns.description: ISO-8601 UTC microsecond timestamp when the row was written.

columns.name: date_utc
columns.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD; selects the Parquet filename.

columns.name: text_len
columns.description: Character length of trimmed request text for predict; 0 for feedback.

columns.name: raw_text
columns.description: Full utterance only when INFERENCE_LOG_RAW_TEXT=1; otherwise null.

columns.name: top_k_ids
columns.description: Ranked topic_id list from fusion (may be non-empty even when UX hides suggestions).

columns.name: top_k_scores
columns.description: Raw fused scores aligned with top_k_ids.

columns.name: top_k_scores_calibrated
columns.description: Calibrated scores where defined (typically top-1 only); null entries otherwise.

columns.name: chosen_topic
columns.description: Feedback chosen_topic_id for event_type=feedback; null for predict.

columns.name: was_in_top_k
columns.description: Reserved for TASK-033 join of feedback to predict logs; always null in TASK-032.

columns.name: latency_ms
columns.description: Predict latency from API response when available; null on validation errors or feedback.

columns.name: model_version
columns.description: Promoted run id (artifacts directory name); empty on feedback rows.

columns.name: taxonomy_version
columns.description: Manifest taxonomy_version; empty on feedback rows.

columns.name: prefix_len_used
columns.description: Query length used with prefix UX metadata (Python len of trimmed text on predict).

columns.name: ux_shown
columns.description: Whether suggestions were returned after server-side prefix gating.

columns.name: conf_channel
columns.description: Prefix policy confidence channel name (e.g. ensemble); empty when unknown.

columns.name: conf_value
columns.description: Scalar confidence used for tau gate; null when unavailable.
